items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: We met Guy Lombardo just about the same time, Guy is from London, Ontario.

ctx.x: I really can't remember exactly what it was because we did have a little problem the last couple of weeks getting our money. It was a beautiful job though. THERE WAS A WHITE BAND UP THERE, FAIRLY WELL KNOWN, IT WASN'T GUY LOMBARDO.

We met Guy Lombardo just about the same time, Guy is from London, Ontario. He was from that same area. We played ballad music with Guy in London, Ontario, that's his home. That's where we first met him. That was before they came over to Cleveland. One of his brothers a saxophone player, not Carmen, the other guy plays tenor, he had a band in Toronto.
FROM CANADA YOU MUST HAVE COME DOWN INTO CLEVELAND. YOU NEVER DID PLAY IN CHICAGO DID YOU.
